Do not use staples, paper clips, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are thirty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet.
What is not an example of the role of the factor enterprise in a modern economy?

options.A: deciding on new export markets for the company’s goods and services
options.B: making payments to suppliers for raw materials and capital goods
options.C: reducing costs through the introduction of a new shift system for employees
options.D: transforming the production process with the introduction of robots

options.C: store of value
options.D: unit of account

questions.questionText: What is it necessary to know in order to calculate the price elasticity of supply of a product when its price changes?

options.A: the amount of the price change; the quantity demanded at the original price; the quantity supplied at the new price
options.B: the equilibrium market price; the quantity demanded at equilibrium; the quantity supplied at equilibrium
options.C: the original and new market price; the quantity supplied at the original price; the quantity supplied at the new price
options.D: the quantity demanded at the new price; the price change; the quantity supplied at the new price

options.C: one
options.D: zero

questions.questionText: Which argument is used to justify a policy of nationalisation?

options.A: A firm exposed to market forces is more likely to be efficient.
options.B: It avoids the wasteful duplication of resources.
options.C: The stock market can exert effective discipline on the industry.
options.D: There are benefits from wider share ownership.
